# REPORT INFORMATION
```{r report_date}
  myReportDate <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
  cat(paste("**Report Date and Time:** ",myReportDate,"\n\n",sep=""))
  myUser <- Sys.getenv("USERNAME")
  cat(paste("**Generated By:** ",myUser,"\n\n",sep=""))
  cat(paste("**CASTfxn Package Version:** ",packageVersion("CASTfxn"),"\n\n",sep=""))
```

# STRESSOR RESPONSE

## BMI
### Tables
```{r SR_BMI_tables}
fn_SR_BMI_Corrs  <- file.path(dir_results, TargetSiteID, "StressRespCorrs.BMI.txt")
fn_SR_BMI_Scores <- file.path(dir_results, TargetSiteID, "StressRespScores.BMI.txt")
#
# captions
cap_SR_BMI_Corrs <- "Stressor Response, BMI, Correlations"
cap_SR_BMI_Scores <- "Stressor Response, BMI, Scores"
#
# if exist run
if(file.exists(fn_SR_BMI_Corrs)==TRUE){##IF.corrs.START
  df_SR_BMI_Corrs <- read.delim(fn_SR_BMI_Corrs)
  knitr::kable(df_SR_BMI_Corrs, caption=cap_SR_BMI_Corrs)
} else {
  cat("No Stressor Response BMI correlations.\n")
}##IF.corrs.START
#
if(file.exists(fn_SR_BMI_Scores)==TRUE){##IF.scores.START
  df_SR_BMI_Scores <- read.delim(fn_SR_BMI_Scores)
  knitr::kable(df_SR_BMI_Scores, caption=cap_SR_BMI_Scores)
} else {
  cat("No Stressor Response BMI scores.\n")
}##IF.scores.START
```

### Plots
```{r SR_BMI_plots}
fn_SR_BMI_Corrs  <- file.path(dir_results, TargetSiteID, "StressRespCorrs.BMI.txt")
#
if(file.exists(fn_SR_BMI_Corrs)==TRUE){
  df_SR_BMI_Corrs <- read.delim(fn_SR_BMI_Corrs)
  Corr_Analyte <- sort(unique(df_SR_BMI_Corrs$stressName))
  fn_img <- list.files(file.path(dir_results, TargetSiteID)
                     , paste0(TargetSiteID,".SR.BMI.", Corr_Analyte), full.names = TRUE)
  knitr::include_graphics(fn_img)
} else {
  cat("No Stressor Response BMI correlation plots.\n")
}
#

```

### Plots
```{r SR_SSTV_plots}
fn_SR_SSTV_Corrs  <- file.path(dir_results, TargetSiteID
                               , paste0(TargetSiteID, ".SSTVCorrs.txt"))
#
df_SR_SSTVCorrs <- read.delim(fn_SR_SSTV_Corrs)
```
